"Bud" Hutchinson was second, and with more serious training might show us some of his Canadian form. S. Jones won the Discus Throw with Bill Sutton as runner-up.

We did, however, manage to have the first two in the Shot Putt, and S. Jones with 37ft. 1in. and Bill Sutton with 36ft. 9½in. are to be complimented on the steady improvement they are showing at this branch of sport.

In conjunction with the racing events we had a Field Event match with the Metropolitan Police A.C., there being three events and scoring for the first six places in each. We triumphed in the Shot Putt by 11 pts. to 10, S. Jones, of the "Bels," having the best putt of 37ft. 5ins.
Our match with the Police proved a success, each side having full teams for each event. In the Weight, S.
In Southern Amateur Athletic League events, with thirteen events decided, we have scored 148 points out of a possible 156. S.

In the Senior 100 yards Southgate proved too strong for us; but Alby Bird credited us with first place in the 880 yards, and Frank Webb ran a fine race, to gain third place in this event. We had the first two in the Shot Putt with S.
